notifications.title: Preparation Phase
notifications.message: Your body is preparing for pregnancy. Folate intake is very important now.

notifications.title: Ovulation Window
notifications.message: This is the most fertile period. Timing is key for conception.

notifications.title: Fertilization
notifications.message: Fertilization may have occurred. The embryo starts forming.

notifications.title: Implantation
notifications.message: The fertilized egg implants in the uterus. Pregnancy officially begins.

notifications.title: Heartbeat Begins
notifications.message: Your baby's heart may start beating this week.

notifications.title: Neural Development
notifications.message: The brain and nervous system are developing rapidly.

notifications.title: Face Formation
notifications.message: Basic facial features begin forming.

notifications.title: Organ Formation
notifications.message: Major organs are developing. Critical development phase.

notifications.title: Fetus Stage Begins
notifications.message: Your baby is now officially called a fetus.

notifications.title: Movement Starts
notifications.message: Small movements begin, even if you can't feel them yet.

notifications.title: Rapid Growth
notifications.message: Your baby is growing quickly and developing structure.

notifications.title: First Trimester Complete
notifications.message: Major organs are formed. Risk of miscarriage decreases.

notifications.title: Second Trimester Begins
notifications.message: Energy levels often improve for the mother.

notifications.title: Muscle Development
notifications.message: Baby starts practicing movements.

notifications.title: Bone Development
notifications.message: Bones are getting stronger with calcium.

notifications.title: Gender Detection Possible
notifications.message: In some cases, baby's gender can be seen via ultrasound.

notifications.title: Fat Storage Begins
notifications.message: Baby starts storing fat for temperature regulation.

notifications.title: You May Feel Movement
notifications.message: First kicks (quickening) may be felt.

notifications.title: Sensory Development
notifications.message: Baby's senses are developing rapidly.

notifications.title: Halfway Point
notifications.message: You are halfway through your pregnancy journey.

notifications.title: Digestive System
notifications.message: Baby begins swallowing amniotic fluid.

notifications.title: Skin Development
notifications.message: Skin layers are forming.

notifications.title: Lung Development
notifications.message: Lungs are developing but not yet ready.

notifications.title: Viability Stage
notifications.message: Baby has a chance of survival outside womb with medical care.

notifications.title: Brain Growth
notifications.message: Rapid brain development is happening.

notifications.title: Eye Opening
notifications.message: Baby may begin to open eyes.

notifications.title: Third Trimester Begins
notifications.message: Final growth and maturation phase starts.

notifications.title: Stronger Movements
notifications.message: Kicks become stronger and more noticeable.

notifications.title: Muscle & Lung Growth
notifications.message: Body systems continue maturing.

notifications.title: Brain Connections
notifications.message: Neural connections increase rapidly.

notifications.title: Sleep Cycles
notifications.message: Baby develops sleep-wake cycles.

notifications.title: Positioning
notifications.message: Baby may start moving into birth position.

notifications.title: Immune Support
notifications.message: Baby receives antibodies from mother.

notifications.title: Fat Gain
notifications.message: Baby gains weight quickly.

notifications.title: Lung Maturity
notifications.message: Lungs are close to full development.

notifications.title: Birth Preparation
notifications.message: Body prepares for labor. Dates may help cervical readiness.

notifications.title: Full Term Approaching
notifications.message: Baby is considered early term.

notifications.title: Ready for Birth
notifications.message: Baby is almost ready to be born.

notifications.title: Full Term
notifications.message: Baby is fully developed and ready for birth.

notifications.title: Due Week
notifications.message: Your baby can arrive any day now.
